_how_to_update: Edit the numbers below about once a month from YouTube Studio, set as_of to the last day of the 28 day window, and commit. Use plain numbers (895000, not 895K). Use null for anything not known yet. monthly_audience is Studio's Monthly audience (viewers). Never add revenue. An automated feed can overwrite this file later in the same shape. A daily job (scripts/update-stats.mjs) refreshes subscribers_total, videos.<id>.views and live_as_of; it never touches the 28 day numbers, monthly_audience or as_of.
